raw.caveat: Pair tables overlap within families and are descriptive; they are not additional independent samples.

current_scope_supplement.caveat: Pair tables overlap within families and are descriptive; they are not additional independent samples.

advancement.explanation: No automatic advancement or benchmark qualification; audit disagreements and missing responses, then coordinator resolves retained-scope validity.

limitations: Fixed development mixture was chosen adaptively from earlier panels; intervals omit selection and oracle uncertainty.
Fresh exact tuples reuse previously exposed development families. Exposure subgroup differences are observational and can be composition-confounded.
Legacy6687 analysis inspected all dictionary families. New campaign reserved-family separation is not a never-seen-lexical-root claim.
Opus-only family dependence cannot identify Astra repeated-aorist covariance or final output-cap effects.
Repeated forms, imbalance and few families in some classes limit resampling interpretations; no estimator choice changes the final precision gate.
